entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I need to process a return for an Aero Road Helmet I purchased a couple of months ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, can I have your order number?

Thank you. I see the order here for the Aero Road Helmet in blaze orange, delivered about 65 days ago. To best help, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It’s a preference thing. I bought it as a gift, but the color wasn't what they wanted. The box is still unopened, we never even took it out.
I understand. Let me just pull up our return policy for you. One moment.
Okay, thank you for waiting. It looks like your purchase is well within our 90-day return window. I can go ahead and approve this return for you immediately. I'll email you a prepaid shipping label.

That's great, thank you. I appreciate how easy that was. Now, since I'll be ordering a different helmet to replace this one, and I'm going through the trouble of shipping this back, is there any possibility of getting a small discount code for my next purchase?

I can definitely see why you'd ask, and we appreciate your continued business. However, our policy doesn't allow for goodwill credits or discounts for returns based on preference, like color choice. We want to make sure you get the right gear, as proper fit and style are key to rider safety.
Understood. No problem, it was worth asking. You can just send the label then. Thank you for your help.

Of course. I've just sent that label to the email on file. You should see it within the next 5 minutes. Once we receive the returned helmet, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks again, Sarah.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
